parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 400,
  "system": "You are a policy analyst classifying state legislation for a B2B GTM team. Return strict JSON only — no preamble, no commentary, no markdown fences.",
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Bill: " + $json.identifier + " — " + $json.title + "
State: " + $json.state + "
Subjects: " + ($json.subjects || []).join(', ') + "
Latest action (" + $json.latest_action_date + "): " + $json.latest_action + "

Classify. Return JSON with exactly these fields:

industries: array of tags from [healthcare, insurance, financial_services, tech, retail, food_service, energy, manufacturing, transportation, education, agriculture, telecom, real_estate, advocacy_seniors, advocacy_consumer]
urgency: integer 1-5 (5=floor vote/signing imminent, 4=committee action this week, 3=active in committee, 2=introduced, 1=dormant)
topic_summary: one sentence, max 25 words.
affected_entities: array of 2-4 short phrases."
  }]
}

={
  "model": "claude-opus-4-7",
  "max_tokens": 300,
  "system": "You are drafting a sales briefing for a state policy intelligence platform's GTM team. Tone: confident, factual, no hype, no exclamation. Output the briefing only — no preamble, no signature.",
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Account: " + $json.account.name + " (" + $json.account.industry + ")
Account state footprint: " + $json.account.state_footprint.join(', ') + "
Bill: " + $json.bill.identifier + " — " + $json.bill.title + " (" + $json.bill.state.toUpperCase() + ")
Topic: " + $json.bill.classification.topic_summary + "
Urgency: " + $json.bill.classification.urgency + "/5
Latest action: " + $json.bill.latest_action + " on " + $json.bill.latest_action_date + "

Write a 3-part briefing for the AE:
1. Why now — one sentence on the trigger.
2. Why this account — one sentence on the specific exposure.
3. Suggested open — one sentence the AE could lead with.

Total length under 80 words."
  }]
}

meta.description: Daily Open States pull -> Claude classification -> vertical-aware scoring -> route to CRM tasks, sequences, or Slack alert. The Python script in scripts/run_pipeline.py is the equivalent reference implementation.
